requirement: Property-test an LRU cache with a Hypothesis RuleBasedStateMachine that compares every operation against a simple list model.
skeleton: An OrderedDict-backed LRUCache with validated capacity, recency-refreshing get and put, and a RuleBasedStateMachine with put and get rules and an order invariant.
caption: An LRU cache verified by a Hypothesis rule-based state machine, using collections OrderedDict and hypothesis strategies and stateful. LRUCache raises ValueError for a capacity below 1; get returns None for a missing key and otherwise moves the key to the most recent end; put refreshes an existing key, stores the value and evicts the oldest key once the size exceeds capacity; keys lists least to most recent. LRUCacheMachine keeps a list model, applies put and get rules to both the cache and the model, and an invariant requires the same recency order. The fixture asserts the machine passes with derandomized settings, get and overwrite refreshing recency, exactly capacity items kept, and the ValueError.

constraints: get and overwriting put both mark the key most recently used
Eviction removes the least recently used key only once size exceeds capacity
The state machine invariant compares recency order to the model

rationale.teaches: Pair a real data structure with a trivially correct model and let a rule-based state machine search for diverging operation sequences.
rationale.why: LRU bugs appear only after specific sequences of reads and writes, which example tests rarely cover but a state machine finds.

ops.docstring: An LRU cache checked against a list model by a Hypothesis state machine.

ops.stmt: from hypothesis import strategies as st
from hypothesis.stateful import RuleBasedStateMachine, invariant, rule

candidates.why_wrong: Reading a key does not protect it, so a hot key is evicted next.
Overwriting an existing key leaves it at its old recency position.
The cache holds one item fewer than its configured capacity.
The newest entry is evicted instead of the least recently used one.
A zero capacity cache is accepted and silently stores nothing.
